attempts.text:
**The window opens on a short spine.** Columns 0 to 1, `lipA` to `tatE`, are carried by 94 to 100% of chromosomes, all persistent, in a region of plasticity in 0% of calls. The model names 99 to 99.8% of them, fewest at column 0, `lipA`, 99%.

**A single variable column follows**, column 2, `ybeM`, carried by 78%. Through columns 61 to 63 a branch of 3 shell families runs in 16 to 35%, and through columns 73 to 77 a branch of 5 shell families runs in 11 to 13%.

**The model names more genes on the spine columns than on the fork and variable ones**, 97 against 84%, and hesitates less there, 0.19 against 0.80 bits. It hesitates most at column 63, `fimZ`, a fork column, 1.85 bits.

**The window ends in fork and variable columns.** Columns 61 to 79 are carried by 21 to 85% of chromosomes, in a region of plasticity in 44 to 93% of calls. The last column is `ylbE`, in 21% of chromosomes.

**Across the window it names 92% of genes**, 0.40 bits on average, perplexity 1.4 families. Inside a region of plasticity it hesitates more than outside, 1.19 against 0.20 bits, and names fewer genes, 78% against 96%.

label: lipA
facts:
[W] WINDOW: the lipA window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor lipA, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 3,104 to 3,183 from dnaA. Read in 540 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying lipA once); 43,200 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
[T] TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
[G] WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 92% of genes, 0.40 bits on average (perplexity 1.4 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 33,280 calls, named 99%, 0.16 bits; shell 9,601 calls, named 73%, 1.19 bits; cloud 319 calls, named 38%, 2.40 bits. Outside an RGP 34,225 calls, named 96%, 0.20 bits; inside an RGP 8,975 calls, named 78%, 1.19 bits. Columns: 52 spine, 18 fork, 10 variable.
[C] COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (1.19 against 0.20 bits) and names fewer genes (78% against 96%); 8,975 of the 43,200 calls are inside an RGP.
[H] HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 63 (fimZ, a fork column) 1.85 bits, RGP 93%; column 62 (ybcH, a fork column) 1.66 bits, RGP 92%; column 64 (sfmF, a fork column) 1.55 bits, RGP 92%. The 16 columns (columns 59-74) where most calls are in an RGP: named 82%, 1.03 bits on average; the other 64 columns: named 95%, 0.25 bits.
[M] BY KIND OF COLUMN (computed, over the columns with calls): the 52 spine columns: named 97%, 0.19 bits on average; the 28 fork and variable columns: named 84%, 0.80 bits. The model names more genes on the spine columns than on the fork and variable ones, and hesitates less there. Its most hesitant column, 63, is a fork column.
[P] PLASTICITY (the stretches below, by their mean over columns): the stretch most in regions of plasticity: columns 61-79 (fork and variable columns), RGP 44-93%; the least: columns 0-1 (spine), RGP 0%.
[L] STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
[S1] 1. columns 0-1 (2 columns) spine: share 94-100%, all P, RGP 0%. Genes: lipA, tatE. named 99-99.8% (mean 99%), fewest named at column 0 (lipA), named 99%; no column of this stretch hesitates more than 0.16 bits (column 0 (lipA)).
[S2] 2. column 2 variable: share 78%, all S, RGP 0%. named 85%; 0.40 bits.
[S2.c2]    2: ybeM S 78% "deaminated glutathione amidase"
[S3] 3. columns 3-17 (15 columns) spine: share 90-94%, all P, RGP 0-4%. Genes: crcB, cspE, pagP, dcuC, dpiA, dpiB "sensor histidine kinase DpiB", citC, citD, citE, citF, citX "citrate lyase holo-[acyl-carrier pr…", citG, citT, rna, rnk. named 96-100% (mean 99%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 5 (pagP), named 96%, 0.41 bits.
[S4] 4. columns 18-19 (2 columns) fork and variable columns: share 61-64%, all S, RGP 5%. named 66-90% (mean 78%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 18, named 66%, 0.71 bits.
[S4.c18]    18 fork: yldA S 61% "small membrane protein YldA"; also yldA (another family) S 26%
[S4.c19]    19 variable: ybdR S 64% "zinc-dependent alcohol dehydrogenase"
[S5] 5. columns 20-23 (4 columns) spine: share 93-94%, all P, RGP 0.4-4%. Genes: uspG, ahpF "alkyl hydroperoxide reductase subun…", ahpC, dsbG. named 95-98% (mean 97%), fewest named at column 21 (ahpF), named 95%; most hesitant at column 23 (dsbG), 0.33 bits.
[S6] 6. column 24 variable: share 87%, all P, RGP 0.2%. named 91%; 0.51 bits.
[S6.c24]    24: ybdN P 87% "phosphoadenosine phosphosulfate red…"
[S7] 7. columns 25-39 (15 columns) spine: share 92-94%, all P, RGP 0.2-1%. Genes: ybdM "IbrB-like domain-containing protein", ybdL "methionine-oxo-acid transaminase", hcxA, ybdD "YbdD/YjiX family protein", cstA, entH, entA, entB "enterobactin biosynthesis bifunctio…", entE, entC, fepB, entS, fepD, fepG "iron-enterobactin ABC transporter p…", fepC. named 91-99% (mean 98%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 25 (ybdM), named 91%, 0.46 bits.
[S8] 8. column 40 variable: share 87%, all P, RGP 1%. named 97%; 0.25 bits.
[S8.c40]    40: wzz(fepE) P 87%
[S9] 9. columns 41-43 (3 columns) spine: share 93-94%, all P, RGP 0.4-1%. Genes: entF, ybdZ "enterobactin biosynthesis protein Y…", fes. named 95-99% (mean 98%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 41 (entF), named 95%, 0.31 bits.
[S10] 10. column 44 variable: share 6%, all P, RGP 1%. named 94%; 0.16 bits.
[S10.c44]    44: fur P 6%
[S11] 11. columns 45-46 (2 columns) spine: share 91-93%, all P, RGP 2-4%. Genes: fepA, entD. named 83-95% (mean 89%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 46 (entD), named 83%, 0.40 bits.
[S12] 12. column 47 fork: share 48%, all S, RGP 9%. named 57%; 0.91 bits.
[S12.c47]    47: "IS4-like element IS421 family transposa…" S 48%; also "hypothetical protein" S 13%

[S14] 14. columns 50-51 (2 columns) variable: share 89-90%, all P, RGP 11%. named 92-96% (mean 94%), fewest named at column 50, named 92%; most hesitant at column 51, 0.45 bits.

[S15] 15. columns 52-60 (9 columns) spine: share 90-94%, all P, RGP 9-88%. [S16] 16. columns 61-79 (19 columns) fork and variable columns: share 21-85%, 11 P, 8 S, RGP 44-93%. named 72-93% (mean 84%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 63, named 72%, 1.85 bits.
